selection_policy: The user chooses which tasks to enable; all may be enabled, or only one of them. A task the user has not explicitly selected must not be created, enabled, or written down as enabled.
routing_note: cronjob_create automatically binds the current session session_key and delivers through that session channel (WeChat/QQ/dashboard/CLI, etc.). No manual binding is needed and no :weixin: session identifier is required; do not refuse creation on the grounds of "WeChat not bound" or "not a WeChat session".
output_contract: The output of every scheduled task must be in Simplified Chinese; output only the final body to be pushed to the user, and never the thinking, reasoning, retrieval, or execution process (process sentences such as I'll / Let me / Now running / search process / retrieval log / script execution log are prohibited); stay silent while running scripts and searching, and output only after the final body is generated.

delivery_policy.daily_receipt: Only after a real channel receipt may you write "today's learning content has been accepted by the channel and the subscription remains enabled".
delivery_policy.weak_delivery_protocol: Generic cron daily delivery must follow this order: first run delivery-check for duplicate detection (by logical date) and stop sending when a record already exists; after generating the content, validate it with validate_output first; once validation passes, record it with delivery-record and only then output the body. This ledger only prevents duplication and is not a delivery receipt; never claim "delivery confirmed" to the user.

tasks.name: Daily Guideline Continuous Learning
tasks.delivery_caveat: Governed by the cron run, with no channel receipt; deduplicated by logical date, preferring a missed send over a duplicate. Before the user selects an authoritative guideline track, the cron run reports "no enabled track yet" honestly and stops; it does not push at random.
tasks.prompt:
[Output requirement] Use Simplified Chinese throughout; run steps 1-4 silently and do not output any thinking/reasoning/execution process (process sentences such as I'll, Let me, Now running, search process, retrieval log, or script output are prohibited); output the body unit only after step 4 validation passes; if you must stop, state the reason in one Simplified Chinese sentence (for example "today's learning content has already been pushed" or "no enabled track yet") without attaching the reasoning process.
Run the daily guideline learning delivery (strictly in order; if any step fails, stop and do not output the body):
1. Get today's date first (Asia/Shanghai, YYYY-MM-DD) and run: python3 scripts/clinical_profile.py delivery-check --logical-date <today>. If already_sent is true, reply "today's learning content has already been pushed" and stop; do not regenerate it.
2. Run: python3 scripts/clinical_profile.py learning-next-lesson to read the next fixed unit. When there is no enabled track or no next unit, state that honestly and stop; do not fabricate content. Use lesson.ordinal and track.progress.planned_units to decide whether this is the final unit.
3. Generate that unit per references/daily-learning-template.md and write the source line (Source: name: [link](URL)): exactly 3 numbered key points; for a non-final unit give the next fixed unit's topic and learning objective; for the final unit, silently verify 2-3 related formal guideline/consensus/standard original texts as "optional guidelines for the next stage (pending confirmation)", each with the full name, year/version, issuing body, authoritative original link, and recommended connection, and state clearly that no new track will be created or enabled before confirmation. Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative/scoping/umbrella/rapid/expert reviews, and research papers may only be used internally to discover formal guidelines and must not enter the final sources, the next-stage candidates, or the learning track sources. When there are not at least 2 verifiable formal guidelines, do not pad with reviews; instead ask the user which learning direction to continue. Then validate with python3 scripts/validate_output.py --module daily_guideline_learning; if it fails, fix it and validate once more, and if it still fails, stop and explain why without outputting the body.
4. After validation passes, run: python3 scripts/clinical_profile.py delivery-record --logical-date <today> --confirm true, then output the unit body. The first line of the body is: [Daily Guideline Learning | {topic}] (unit {ordinal}/{total}).

tasks.name: Professional Guideline Update Alert
tasks.prompt:
[Output requirement] Use Simplified Chinese throughout; output only the final reminder body and no thinking/retrieval/reasoning process (process sentences such as I'll, Let me, search process, or retrieval log are prohibited); stay silent while searching and verifying; the first line of the body is [Professional Guideline Update Alert | {department}].
Run the Professional Guideline Update Alert: first run python3 scripts/clinical_profile.py get to obtain the department/subspecialty/title depth/region; search the allowlisted sources in references/source-policy.yaml for recent updates to guidelines/consensus documents/standards/clinical pathways/quality-control standards; output per the template in references/output-templates.md, including the source line (Source: name: [link](URL)); when there is no reliable update, output the no-update template (--allow-no-source may be used); before sending, validate with python3 scripts/validate_output.py --module guideline_update_reminder. Do not output SOPs/prescriptions/individual diagnosis or treatment/reimbursement conclusions.

tasks.name: Regional Insurance Policy Change Study
tasks.prompt:
[Output requirement] Use Simplified Chinese throughout; output only the final body and no thinking/retrieval/reasoning process (process sentences such as I'll, Let me, search process, or retrieval log are prohibited); stay silent while searching; the first line of the body is [Insurance Policy Change Study | {region}].
Run the regional Insurance Policy Change Study: first run python3 scripts/clinical_profile.py get to obtain the region; search for recent changes in the formal documents of that region's medical insurance bureau/medical insurance office; output per the template in references/output-templates.md with the original-text summary + source line (Source: name: [link](URL)) + local confirmation reminder; do not output reimbursement conclusions; before sending, validate with python3 scripts/validate_output.py --module insurance_policy_learning.
